objective: Diagnosticar en POS MPRO 130QRO el/los tickets del 08/08/2026 con venta neta positiva en Venta_Encabezado pero suma de detalle monetario no positiva, que siguen bloqueando el backfill post-R15B. Solo lectura.

queries.name: qro_0808_positive_net_zero_gross
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT v.Vn_Folio, v.Vn_Documento, v.Vn_Fecha, v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal,
         ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'') AS estado_origen,
         CAST(ISNULL(v.Vn_Precio_Neto_Importe,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS neto_header
  FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)='2026-08-08'
    AND ISNULL(v.Vn_Tabla,'')='Comanda'
    AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'') IN ('AC','FA','CA')
), d AS (
  SELECT h.Vn_Folio,h.Vn_Documento,h.Vn_Fecha,h.Sc_Cve_Sucursal,h.estado_origen,h.neto_header,
         COUNT(d.Co_Folio) AS lineas_detalle,
         CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Importe,0) AS decimal(19,4))),0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS bruto_detalle,
         CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Cantidad,0) AS decimal(19,4))),0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS cantidad_detalle
  FROM h
  LEFT JOIN Comanda_Detalle d WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON d.Co_Folio=h.Vn_Documento
   AND ISNULL(d.Es_Cve_Estado,'') IN ('AC','FA')
  GROUP BY h.Vn_Folio,h.Vn_Documento,h.Vn_Fecha,h.Sc_Cve_Sucursal,h.estado_origen,h.neto_header
)
SELECT Vn_Folio,Vn_Documento,Vn_Fecha,Sc_Cve_Sucursal,estado_origen,neto_header,lineas_detalle,bruto_detalle,cantidad_detalle
FROM d
WHERE estado_origen IN ('AC','FA')
  AND neto_header>0
  AND bruto_detalle<=0
ORDER BY neto_header DESC,Vn_Folio

queries.name: qro_0808_problem_detail_rows
queries.sql:
WITH bad AS (
  SELECT v.Vn_Documento
  FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK)
  LEFT JOIN Comanda_Detalle d WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON d.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento
   AND ISNULL(d.Es_Cve_Estado,'') IN ('AC','FA')
  WHERE CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)='2026-08-08'
    AND ISNULL(v.Vn_Tabla,'')='Comanda'
    AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'') IN ('AC','FA')
    AND ISNULL(v.Vn_Precio_Neto_Importe,0)>0
  GROUP BY v.Vn_Documento
  HAVING ISNULL(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(d.Cd_Importe,0) AS decimal(19,4))),0)<=0
)
SELECT TOP 200 d.Co_Folio,d.Pr_Cve_Producto,d.Cd_Concepto,d.Cd_Cantidad,d.Cd_Precio,d.Cd_Importe,d.Es_Cve_Estado
FROM Comanda_Detalle d WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN bad b ON b.Vn_Documento=d.Co_Folio
ORDER BY d.Co_Folio,d.Pr_Cve_Producto
